description: Source code for wpa_supplicant ucode integration, managing interface and BSS state updates via a ucode VM and registry.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_iface_get_uval
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ucode resource value for a given wpa_supplicant interface.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_update_interfaces
methods.description: Updates the list of interfaces in the ucode registry.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_add_bss
methods.description: Adds a new BSS interface to the ucode registry.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_free_bss
methods.description: Removes a BSS interface from the ucode registry.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_update_state
methods.description: Updates the state of a wpa_supplicant interface in the ucode registry.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_event
methods.description: Handles a wpa_supplicant event and updates the ucode registry accordingly.

methods.name: uc_wpas_add_iface
methods.description: Lua binding to add a new interface via ucode.

methods.name: uc_wpas_remove_iface
methods.description: Lua binding to remove an interface via ucode.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_status
methods.description: Lua binding to get the status of an interface.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_ctrl
methods.description: Lua binding to send a control command to an interface.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_init
methods.description: Initializes the ucode subsystem for wpa_supplicant.
